Manipulative.name: Manipulative
Manipulative.description:
🕸️ People are pieces to you, and you know which strings move each of them.

🎭 You read weaknesses and desires and turn them into leverage.
⚠️ Once someone sees through you, they never trust you again, and they talk.
⚠️ Real friendship is hard when everyone is a piece on a board.
🔀 If you are also Honest, you never lie; you only choose which truths to tell.

📈 Grants: Deception +5, Psychology +5
Manipulative.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is manipulative: they read people's weaknesses and desires and use them as leverage, steering others while letting them think it was their own idea. Weakness: anyone who sees through them never trusts them again and warns others, and real friendship is hard when everyone is a piece on a board. If the character is also Honest, they never lie and only choose which truths to tell. The narrator lets the people they work on think and push back; who they manipulate is the player's decision.
